# Independent rebel-guarded (fx17) fallback monthly pulse for Maghreb, Barbary & Africa Exarchate (1337-1680, slot 63).
# When scheduler slot 63 already ticked this month, oe_mag_ran_m equals oe_mag_m_now and this trigger evaluates false.
# Guarantees the line ticks smoothly even if BYZ/ROM falls or the human plays MOR / TUN / TLE / MAL / SON.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_mag_fallback_pulse } }

oe_mag_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        oe_mag_pulse_host_candidate = yes
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_done }
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_ran_m }
            NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_ran_m = oe_mag_m_now }

    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_mag_monthly = yes }
    }
}
